column1: # The Japanese reconstruction of the American one-part code, seen through its errors: every word of the FRUS text of the 53 compared telegrams,
# with how the Japanese copies rendered it. status: known = always read right; partly known = right here, wrong or blank elsewhere;
# misplaced = only replaced by another word (group assigned to the wrong word); unknown = only blank or initials; omitted = only missing.
# position_web2 = normalised rank of the word in the web2 word list (0-1), a proxy for its place in an alphabetical code book.
